title: Uniform bound on Dφ for a C¹ map equal to the identity off a compact set
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, K ⊆ ℝ^P compact, and φ : ℝ^P → ℝ^P a C¹ map with φ(x) = x for every x ∉ K. Then there is Λ ∈ ℝ with Λ ≥ 0 and ‖Dφ(x)‖ ≤ Λ for every x ∈ ℝ^P, where Dφ(x) = fderiv ℝ φ x ∈ L(ℝ^P, ℝ^P) and ‖·‖ is the operator norm.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (K : Set (Euclid P)) (φ : Euclid P → Euclid P), IsCompact K → ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → (∀ x, x ∉ K → φ x = x) → ∃ Λ : ℝ, 0 ≤ Λ ∧ ∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ φ x‖ ≤ Λ
